text: A muscular male figure with fair skin sits on a rock, gripping a thick vine. His blonde hair is long and tied back in a braid. He has a lean, athletic build and an angular face with closed eyes. He wears a brown belt with gold buckle, dark shorts, and black boots. A single gold medallion hangs from his neck. The pose suggests rest or contemplation amidst a twilight jungle setting with purple-hued trees and vines.
